# Vendored libraries

Pre-built browser bundles, committed so the demo loads nothing from a CDN at runtime.
To update one, download the new bundle from the same URL with the new version and
update this table.

| File | Library | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | marked (Markdown → HTML, for the reports) | 12.0.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@12.0.2/marked.min.js | MIT (`LICENSE.marked.md`) |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify (sanitizes the rendered reports) | 3.1.6 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.1.6/dist/purify.min.js | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 (`LICENSE.dompurify`) |
